title: Direct-image difference diagram for two arbitrary ambient opens
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $U,V$ be arbitrary opens of $X$, and put $W=U\cap V$. Fix the four derived categories of module sheaves on $X,U,V,W$ in one morphism universe [def-pc-derived-category]. Let $r_U,r_V,r_W$ be the exact derived open restrictions, $s_U,s_V$ the exact overlap restrictions, and $e_U:r_U\mathbin{\star}s_U\cong r_W$, $e_V:r_V\mathbin{\star}s_V\cong r_W$ their canonical composition isomorphisms [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps], where $\star$ means first the left functor and then the right functor. Given $A\in D(\mathcal O_U)$, $B\in D(\mathcal O_V)$ and $c:s_U(A)\cong s_V(B)$, put $E=Rj_{U,*}A\oplus Rj_{V,*}B$ and $D=Rj_{W,*}(s_VB)$ using the derived direct images [def-pc-derived-direct-image]. Then there exist $d:E\to D$, $p_U:r_U(E)\to A$, $p_V:r_V(E)\to B$ and $k:r_W(D)\to s_V(B)$ such that $(p_U,r_U(d)):r_U(E)\to A\oplus r_U(D)$ and $(p_V,r_V(d)):r_V(E)\to B\oplus r_V(D)$ are isomorphisms and $e_{U,E}^{-1};s_U(p_U);c-e_{V,E}^{-1};s_V(p_V)=r_W(d);k$, where the semicolon denotes composition in execution order. The two objects are these fixed direct-image constructions. This constructs only their difference diagram; it neither chooses a fiber of $d$ nor asserts an object restricting to $A$ and $B$. No covering hypothesis is imposed; no object of the fiber triangle is asserted.

proof.text: Construct the derived open adjunctions by deriving the exact restriction/direct-image adjunctions. For W=U∩V take E=RjU_*A⊕RjV_*B and D=RjW_*(sV B), using [def-pc-derived-direct-image]. Define pU and pV as the projection to the corresponding direct-image summand followed by its open counit. The adjoints of the overlap counits, followed by c on the U side and a minus sign on the V side, give d. Take k to be the W counit. The composition comparison of [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps] identifies the two iterated adjunctions; naturality and their triangle identities give the displayed difference equation.

proof.text: Apply [lem-pc-restrict-derived-direct-image-open] to the open immersions of U,V,W. On U identify rU E with A⊕Rj_*(sV B) and rU D with Rj_*(sV B), where j:W→U. In these coordinates pU=(1,0) and rU d=(a,-1) for the adjoint of c. The matrix (pU,rU d) has inverse (x,y)↦(x,a x-y). On V reorder the summands: pV is projection to B and the other diagonal entry of rV d is the direct image of c, an isomorphism. The triangular matrix is again invertible. With W empty the second summands vanish; with an entire open the same counit/matrix argument applies. These cases require no extra hypotheses.
